cues.en: Instructor: In the previous video, I taught you several different measures of dispersion.
cues.zh: 前一部影片，介紹了幾個不同的離散程度量。

cues.en: And so now in this video, we are going to see all of these different measures computed in MATLAB code and of course, in Python code in a few minutes.
cues.zh: 這部影片，看看如何用MATLAB計算，幾分鐘後，當然也用Python。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: I'm going to create three different distributions.
cues.zh: 建立三個不同分布。

cues.en: This code might look familiar.
cues.zh: 程式碼可能很眼熟。

cues.en: In fact, this is exactly the same code, literally copied and pasted, as the code for the video on central tendencies.
cues.zh: 其實和集中趨勢影片完全相同，直接複製貼上。

cues.en: So I'm not even going to discuss it, I'm just going to run the code.
cues.zh: 所以不討論，直接執行。

cues.en: This does the mean that you've seen before.
cues.zh: 這裡計算之前看過的平均。

cues.en: And then here is where things are starting to get new for this video.
cues.zh: 這裡開始是本部的新內容。

cues.en: So we're gonna compute the standard deviation here and we have three different distributions or three different data sets.
cues.zh: 計算標準差，有三個分布、三個資料集。

cues.en: So we need to compute three different standard deviations.
cues.zh: 所以要算三個標準差。

cues.en: Now I'm using a little bit of weird code here.
cues.zh: 這裡程式碼有點奇怪。

cues.en: This is using the MATLAB eval function.
cues.zh: 用MATLAB的eval函式。

cues.en: And essentially, what the eval function will allow you to do is input a string and MATLAB will evaluate that string
cues.zh: 基本上，讓你輸入字串，MATLAB會把它，

cues.en: as if it is a line of code.
cues.zh: 當成一行程式執行。

cues.en: So for example, I'll set i to be 1 here.
cues.zh: 例如，先設i=1。

cues.en: So now I'm using this function inside eval, sprintf, which is to print out a formatted string and that looks like this.
cues.zh: eval裡使用sprintf，列印格式化字串，長這樣。

cues.en: So we have stds, which is this variable here for the standard deviations for the three different data sets, equals std, which is the MATLAB function
cues.zh: stds是這個變數，存放三個資料集的標準差，等於std，也就是MATLAB，

cues.en: to compute the standard deviation, and then here I have this %g and then a d and a %g.
cues.zh: 計算標準差的函式。這裡有%g，再有d和%g。

cues.en: So the %g is inherited from this old school FORTRAN programming language and it basically just allows us to specify
cues.zh: %g沿用古老FORTRAN語言的寫法，基本上能指定，

cues.en: or to substitute a variable for this character here.
cues.zh: 或用變數取代這個字元。

cues.en: So %g gets replaced with this first character or this first variable, which is i and then this is also i.
cues.zh: %g由第一個變數i取代，這裡也用i。

cues.en: So in the end, this becomes standard deviations 1 equals the standard deviation of d1 or dataset 1.
cues.zh: 最後成為，標準差陣列第一個值，等於d1、第一個資料集的標準差。

cues.en: Now there's no particular reason to have this line of code other than showing you some more advanced applications in MATLAB.
cues.zh: 這行沒有特別理由，只是展示更進階的MATLAB應用。

cues.en: So some advanced ways of using MATLAB.
cues.zh: 一些進階用法。

cues.en: But anyway, the upshot of all this code is that we end up with this variable here, stds for the standard deviations and that's the standard deviations
cues.zh: 總之，最後得到變數stds，存放標準差，也就是，

cues.en: of these three different datasets.
cues.zh: 這三個資料集的標準差。

cues.en: So you can see it's around 1, 3 and 1.
That shouldn't be surprising, given these scaling factors that I had here.
cues.zh: 考量這裡的縮放因子，應該不意外。

cues.en: No scaling factor here, we could call this 1 times and then here is 3 and then here is 1 again.
cues.zh: 這裡沒寫縮放因子，可以想成乘1，這裡3，這裡又是1。

cues.en: Let's see and then I'm just going to draw some lines on top.
cues.zh: 接著在上面畫幾條線。

cues.en: So that draws these thick bars here.
cues.zh: 也就是這些粗線。

cues.en: And what I'm illustrating to you here is the mean minus 1 standard deviation to the mean plus 1 standard deviation.
cues.zh: 展示的是平均減一個標準差，到平均加一個標準差。

cues.en: So that means that these bars show the total of the data points that are within 1 standard deviation below the mean to 1 standard deviation above the mean.
cues.zh: 所以線段顯示，低於平均一個標準差，到高於平均一個標準差之間的所有資料點。

cues.en: So one standard deviation surrounding the mean.
cues.zh: 也就是平均周圍一個標準差。

cues.en: Now, of course, this interpretation that I just said, that is true for distributions that are roughly Gaussian distributed, more or less normally distributed.
cues.zh: 這個解讀，適用於大致高斯、常態分布。

cues.en: You can imagine what this would look like for a a bimodal distribution where the mean is gonna be in the center, the standard deviation is gonna be large,
cues.zh: 可以想像雙峰分布，平均在中間、標準差很大，

cues.en: but a lot of the data are clustered below and above the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 但很多資料聚在標準差範圍下方與上方。

cues.en: In the previous video, I also discussed several different measures of variance, a few different ways of changing or modifying the variance formula.
cues.zh: 前一部也談過幾種變異數量，以及改變、修改公式的方式。

cues.en: And that's basically what we are doing in this code here.
cues.zh: 這段程式就在做這件事。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do in this code inside this for loop is generate data that has a variance or standard deviation that's defined by these different numbers.
cues.zh: for迴圈內，產生變異數或標準差，由這些不同數字定義的資料。

cues.en: So just going from 1 through 10, creating data distributions with different dispersions.
cues.zh: 從1到10，建立不同離散程度的分布。

cues.en: And then down here, I'm computing several different measures of variance.
cues.zh: 下面計算幾個不同的變異程度量。

cues.en: So let's start up with this one.
cues.zh: 先從這個開始。

cues.en: So here I have all the data points squared, except it's not just the data points, it's the data points centered, says data centered, mean centered.
cues.zh: 所有資料點平方，但不是原資料，而是中心化、平均中心化的datacent。

cues.en: So I'm subtracting the average of the data values from all the individual data points.
cues.zh: 從每個資料點，減去資料平均。

cues.en: So that gives me the data points minus the mean squared and then I sum over all of those and then I divide by N minus 1.
cues.zh: 得到各點減平均的平方，加總，再除以N−1。

cues.en: And you'll remember from the previous video, that is the key formula for variance.
cues.zh: 記得前一部，這是變異數的關鍵公式。

cues.en: That is how we compute variance.
cues.zh: 就是這樣算變異數。

cues.en: And now here, this code is almost exactly the same, except this is dividing by N instead of dividing by N minus 1.
cues.zh: 這裡幾乎相同，但除以N，而非N−1。

cues.en: So this is for the population variance, that's what I discussed in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這是母體變異數，前一部談過。

cues.en: But if you apply this variance equation to a sample dataset instead of to a population dataset, then that's called a biased variance term
cues.zh: 但套用於樣本，而非母體，就叫有偏變異數，

cues.en: and it's called biased, because it's going to be, in general, an underestimate of the true variance.
cues.zh: 叫有偏，因為一般會低估真實變異數。

cues.en: And that's because the denominator here is larger than the denominator here.
cues.zh: 因為這裡分母比那裡大。

cues.en: So this fraction is or this ratio is going to be generally larger than this one.
cues.zh: 所以這個比值，通常比另一個大。

cues.en: And so therefore this biased variance is actually going to underestimate the variance in general.
cues.zh: 因此有偏變異數，通常低估變異數。

cues.en: Of course, that's not always trivially the case that there is a bias or the direction of the bias.
cues.zh: 當然，偏差與偏差方向，不是永遠那麼直接。

cues.en: It depends a little bit on how you're sampling from the data, which depends on random chance and so on.
cues.zh: 稍微取決於如何抽樣，也與隨機機會有關。

cues.en: Nonetheless, this is called biased variance and this is called the unbiased variance.
cues.zh: 不過，這叫有偏變異數，這叫不偏變異數。

cues.en: Here we have the standard deviation and you can see that it's just literally the variance and then I'm putting it inside the square root function.
cues.zh: 這是標準差，直接把變異數放進平方根函式。

cues.en: And then here I'm also computing the mean absolute difference and that I discussed in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這裡也計算前一部談的平均絕對差。

cues.en: That's what happens when you take the mean centered data and you take the absolute value and you sum over the absolute values
cues.zh: 取平均中心化的資料，再取絕對值，加總絕對值，

cues.en: instead of squaring all of these values.
cues.zh: 而非把所有值平方。

cues.en: So we compute these for random data sets with different standard deviations and then we're just going to plot them.
cues.zh: 對不同標準差的隨機資料集計算，再畫圖。

cues.en: So here we can see what this looks like and interesting to note a couple of things.
cues.zh: 看看樣子，有幾點值得注意。

cues.en: First of all, these two lines up here that are growing really fast are the variance and the biased variance.
cues.zh: 上方快速增長的兩條線，是變異數與有偏變異數。

cues.en: Now on your video screen, on your computer screen, it might not look like these are two lines, it might just look like it's one line and that's because the biased variance and the variance
cues.zh: 螢幕上可能看不出兩條，像只有一條，因為有偏與不偏變異數，

cues.en: are really, really similar to each other for such a large number.
cues.zh: 在這麼大的數量下，非常接近。

cues.en: So we have N equals 300.
So here we're dividing by 299 versus dividing by 300.
cues.zh: 分別除以299與300。

cues.en: So technically, those are different numbers, but you can see that because N is pretty big, the effect of dividing by N minus 1 versus N
cues.zh: 技術上不同，但N很大，除N−1或N的影響，

cues.en: is really, really small.
cues.zh: 非常非常小。

cues.en: We'd have to really zoom in here to see that these lines are, in fact, different.
cues.zh: 得大幅放大，才看得出兩條線不同。

cues.en: And then the variance involves a lot of squaring.
cues.zh: 變異數涉及平方。

cues.en: So the variance grows really large really fast and the standard deviation doesn't increase as fast, because we're taking the square root.
cues.zh: 所以增加得非常快，標準差沒那麼快，因為取平方根。

cues.en: So we're, in some sense, kind of undoing the squared term there, not exactly literally undoing it, but we are preventing the variance from growing really high
cues.zh: 某種程度像抵銷平方，不完全是字面抵銷，但能避免變異數變得很高，

cues.en: by taking the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 透過取標準差。

cues.en: And then you can see that the MAD, the mean absolute difference is also a little bit different from standard deviation.
cues.zh: MAD、平均絕對差，也與標準差稍有不同。

cues.en: So in general, you see that unbiased and biased variance are really similar to each other.
cues.zh: 整體上，不偏與有偏變異數很接近。

cues.en: Those two are very different from standard deviation and the mean absolute difference and standard deviation and the mean absolute difference are generally going to be pretty similar
cues.zh: 它們和標準差、平均絕對差很不同；而標準差與平均絕對差，整體大致，

cues.en: to each other overall.
cues.zh: 相近。

cues.en: Now you can try playing around with this code a little bit more.
cues.zh: 可以再調整程式。

cues.en: One thing you can try for example is decreasing N.
cues.zh: 例如，減小N。

cues.en: So let's say you make N to be, I don't know, 10, this is a pretty small data set.
cues.zh: 假設N=10，資料集很小。

cues.en: We'll say N equals 10.
Then you'll start to see more differences between the unbiased and the biased variance, because dividing by 10 versus 9 is a bigger deal.
cues.zh: 就更看得出不偏與有偏變異數的差異，因為除以10或9，影響較大。

cues.en: It's a bigger difference than dividing by 300 versus 299.
cues.zh: 比除以300與299，差異更大。

cues.en: So then the last thing I want to show you here is the Fano factor and the coefficient of variation.
cues.zh: 最後示範Fano因子與變異係數。

cues.en: These are concepts that I introduced you to towards the end of the previous video.
cues.zh: 前一部影片最後介紹過。

cues.en: So I'm generating noise now according to what's called a Poisson distribution.
cues.zh: 現在依所謂卜瓦松分布產生雜訊。

cues.en: So this is random numbers that are Poisson distributed.
cues.zh: 也就是卜瓦松分布隨機數。

cues.en: This is how you spell Poisson.
cues.zh: Poisson這樣拼。

cues.en: So let's first see what these data look like.
cues.zh: 先看看資料。

cues.en: So the first thing that strikes you about Poisson noise or Poisson distributed data is that it's only taking a limited number of values on the y-axis.
cues.zh: 第一個特徵，是y軸只取有限幾個值。

cues.en: And in fact, Poisson data are integer-based.
cues.zh: 卜瓦松資料其實是整數。

cues.en: And essentially, the reason for that is Poisson noise is measuring the number of iterations that it takes to achieve some value, given some random process.
cues.zh: 基本原因，是它衡量某個隨機過程，達到某個值需要的迭代次數。

cues.en: I'm not gonna spend a lot of time talking about Poisson noise here, because it's not so relevant for the kinds of statistics we're talking about in this course.
cues.zh: 不會花太多時間談，因為與本課程介紹的統計不太相關。

cues.en: But the main reason why I simulated these, well, there's a couple reasons why I simulated Poisson noise here.
cues.zh: 這裡模擬卜瓦松雜訊，有幾個理由。

cues.en: One is that to compute the Fano factor and the CV, we need positive value data.
cues.zh: 第一，算Fano因子與CV，需要正值資料。

cues.en: And why is that the case?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: I actually explained it in the previous video, in case you don't remember.
cues.zh: 前一部解釋過，萬一你忘了。

cues.en: Let's see, here is a histogram of those data.
cues.zh: 這是資料直方圖。

cues.en: So you see what this Poisson random noise looks like with parameters, it's called the Lambda parameter of 3.
cues.zh: 看到卜瓦松隨機雜訊的樣子，參數叫λ，這裡是3。

cues.en: So now I'm gonna compute the Fano factor and CV for a range of Lambda parameters.
cues.zh: 現在對一系列λ參數，計算Fano因子與CV。

cues.en: So I'm going to change the Lambda parameter inside this Poisson random noise function and compute the coefficient of variation and the Fano factor.
cues.zh: 在卜瓦松隨機雜訊函式中改λ，再算變異係數與Fano因子。

cues.en: You can see that the formulas are pretty similar for both of these.
cues.zh: 兩者公式很相似。

cues.en: It's just the standard deviation divided by the mean of the data or the variance of the data divided by the mean of the data.
cues.zh: 只是標準差除以平均，或變異數除以平均。

cues.en: And then I'm gonna plot these.
cues.zh: 接著畫圖。

cues.en: So plot the CV and the Fano factor as a function of the Lambda for the Poisson random noise.
cues.zh: 把CV與Fano因子，畫成卜瓦松雜訊λ的函數。

cues.en: And then this plot looks pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 圖很有意思。

cues.en: So it seems like the Fano factor is roughly constant around 1, it's kind of dipping down and up and the coefficient of variation is smoothly monotonically,
cues.zh: Fano因子大致維持1附近，上下波動；變異係數則平滑、單調，

cues.en: but non-linearly, going down with an increase in this Lambda parameter.
cues.zh: 但非線性地，隨λ增加而下降。

cues.en: Now this dip here, these are just random, because we're only sampling a finite amount of data.
cues.zh: 這裡的下降只是隨機，因為只抽有限資料。

cues.en: If I were to run this multiple times, you'd see that there is some features of these graphs that are consistent, but these individual ups and downs are not really consistent.
cues.zh: 多執行幾次，會看到某些特徵一致，但個別起伏不一致。

cues.en: So it turns out, interestingly enough, that one wild feature of Poisson noise is that the mean and the variance are exactly the same in theory.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，卜瓦松雜訊的特性之一，是理論上平均與變異數完全相同。

cues.en: When you sample, of course, they're not gonna be exactly the same.
cues.zh: 抽樣時，當然不會完全相同。

cues.en: So that's interesting, because the Fano factor of Poisson distributed data, in theory, is exactly 1.
cues.zh: 因此，卜瓦松資料的Fano因子，理論上恰好是1。

cues.en: And in practice, when you're sampling with random numbers and so on, it's gonna be close to 1, but not necessarily exactly 1.
cues.zh: 實務上，抽取隨機數時，接近1，但不一定恰好1。

cues.en: So in fact, that is one of the reasons, one of the applications of the Fano factor in science, in physics and in neuroscience, in computational biology,
cues.zh: 這是Fano因子在科學、物理、神經科學、計算生物中的應用之一。

cues.en: if you want to know whether a particular phenomenon in nature is distributed like Poisson noise, you can compute the Fano factor
cues.zh: 若想知道自然現象，是否像卜瓦松雜訊那樣分布，可以算Fano因子，

cues.en: and if the Fano factor of your dataset is really close to 1, then you are working with Poisson noise.
cues.zh: 若非常接近1，就是在處理卜瓦松雜訊。

cues.en: So that's evidence that you're working with Poisson noise.
cues.zh: 這是卜瓦松雜訊的證據。

cues.en: So that's just a interesting little side note that I wanted to mention here.
cues.zh: 只是想提這個有趣的小補充。

cues.en: So here we are in Python.
cues.zh: 現在來到Python。

cues.en: Import some of these libraries.
cues.zh: 匯入幾個程式庫。

cues.en: Now this code should look a little bit familiar from the previous video or a couple videos ago on computing central tendency.
cues.zh: 這段程式應該很熟悉，前一部或前幾部計算集中趨勢看過。

cues.en: In fact, this is exactly the same code.
cues.zh: 其實完全相同。

cues.en: I just copied and pasted it, so I'm not really going to talk about it at all.
cues.zh: 直接複製貼上，所以完全不談。

cues.en: Let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: I did want to mention one thing very quickly.
cues.zh: 想快速說一件事。

cues.en: Just about some Python formatting.
cues.zh: 關於Python格式。

cues.en: So you see, what I often do is create these datasets using the randn function where I input only the number of numbers that I want to get out
cues.zh: 我常用randn建立資料，只輸入想取得的數量，

cues.en: and then I can change the variance or the standard deviation and I can change the mean by these stretching and shifting parameters.
cues.zh: 再透過伸縮、平移參數，改變變異數、標準差與平均。

cues.en: There's also a function in the NumPy toolbox in the random submodule and it's called normal.
cues.zh: NumPy的random子模組，還有normal函式。

cues.en: It's basically the same as randn, but we just input some of these parameters directly.
cues.zh: 基本上和randn一樣，但直接輸入某些參數。

cues.en: So this line of code is equivalent to this line of code.
cues.zh: 這行與這行等價。

cues.en: Now the outputs are not gonna be identical, because these are randomly sampled, but just FYI in case you don't feel like hitting the star sign and the plus sign,
cues.zh: 輸出不會完全相同，因為隨機抽樣。只是告訴你，如果不想按乘號、加號，

cues.en: you can input these parameters directly into the normal function.
cues.zh: 可以直接把參數輸入normal。

cues.en: That was all I wanted to mention quickly.
cues.zh: 只是快速提一下。

cues.en: So here, this is still repeat from previous code and now, that's basically just setting up these variables.
cues.zh: 這裡仍重複先前程式，基本上只是建立變數。

cues.en: Now what I want to do is compute the standard deviations of these three datasets and plot them on top of that plot.
cues.zh: 現在算三個資料集的標準差，畫到圖上。

cues.en: So this is really important to keep in mind about Python and I don't know why they do this, but unfortunately, they always do this.
cues.zh: Python這點很重要，不知道為什麼，但很不幸總是如此。

cues.en: So the Python NumPy standard deviation and variance functions, by default, actually compute the population standard deviation
cues.zh: Python NumPy的標準差與變異數函式，預設其實算母體標準差，

cues.en: and the population variance.
cues.zh: 與母體變異數。

cues.en: These are called biased measures of standard deviation and variance.
cues.zh: 這些稱為有偏的標準差與變異數量。

cues.en: I'm gonna talk more about that in a moment and show you what the implications are.
cues.zh: 稍後會詳談並展示影響。

cues.en: But so whenever you are computing standard deviation or variance in Python, you have to remember to input or to provide
cues.zh: 所以Python計算標準差或變異數時，必須記得提供，

cues.en: this second input, which is ddof, that is denominator degrees of freedom, and you have to set that equal to 1.
cues.zh: 第二個輸入ddof，也就是分母自由度，設成1。

cues.en: The default parameter is zero and that is technically not the correct thing to do.
cues.zh: 預設是0，技術上不是正確做法。

cues.en: It should actually be a value of one.
cues.zh: 其實應該是1。

cues.en: So here I compute three standard deviations for the three different datasets and then just doing some plotting.
cues.zh: 這裡算三個資料集的三個標準差，再畫圖。

cues.en: And here's what the plot looks like.
cues.zh: 圖長這樣。

cues.en: So what I'm visualizing here with this thick bar is all the data points that fall within one standard deviation of the mean of the distribution.
cues.zh: 這條粗線，顯示在分布平均周圍一個標準差內的資料點。

cues.en: So that's what you can see here.
cues.zh: 這裡看得到。

cues.en: I'm plotting the x-coordinates go from the mean minus one standard deviation to the mean plus one standard deviation.
cues.zh: x座標從平均減一個標準差，到平均加一個標準差。

cues.en: And that means that most of the data or a lot of the data are contained within this range here.
cues.zh: 代表大部分、或很多資料，在這個範圍。

cues.en: And same thing for the blue and for the black distributions.
cues.zh: 藍色與黑色也一樣。

cues.en: Now this statement that I just made, that most of the data are contained within this red bar, because this is two standard deviations around the mean, that is true only for data
cues.zh: 剛才說，大部分資料在紅線內，因為這是平均周圍合計兩個標準差的寬度；這只適用於，

cues.en: that are roughly normally distributed.
cues.zh: 大致常態資料。

cues.en: So data that have a distribution shape with one peak where it goes down to zero at both sides and it comes up to one peak in the middle.
cues.zh: 也就是兩邊降到0，中間只有一峰的分布。

cues.en: Again, these never have to be absolutely pure Gaussians, they just have to be sort of bell curve-ish.
cues.zh: 不必是完全純粹高斯，大致鐘形即可。

cues.en: And then the standard deviation is a useful and valid measure of central tendency.
cues.zh: 這樣標準差就是實用、有效的集中趨勢量。

cues.en: In the previous video, I showed you in the slides, several ways that you can or several possibilities for changing the variance formula.
cues.zh: 前一部投影片，展示過修改變異數公式的幾種可能。

cues.en: And so I want to illustrate those different methods here in this for loop.
cues.zh: 在for迴圈中示範。

cues.en: So what we're doing inside this for loop is creating some Gaussian distributed data, some random normal data, scaling it by these variances that I list here.
cues.zh: 產生高斯、常態隨機資料，以這些變異數縮放。

cues.en: Standard deviations actually, but it doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 其實是標準差，但無所謂。

cues.en: The point is that we are changing the shape of the width of the distribution, the dispersion around the mean and then I'm computing a couple of different measures
cues.zh: 重點是改變分布寬度、平均周圍的離散程度，再計算不同的，

cues.en: of variability of dispersion.
cues.zh: 變異、離散程度量。

cues.en: So let's have a look at these formulas here.
cues.zh: 看看公式。

cues.en: So here I'm computing the datacent, this variable datacent squared, and datacent is the data mean centered essentially.
cues.zh: 計算datacent平方，datacent是平均中心化資料。

cues.en: So it's the data minus the mean of the data.
cues.zh: 也就是資料減平均。

cues.en: So we square all of those data points, some over all of those square data points and then divide by N.
cues.zh: 把資料點平方，加總，再除以N。

cues.en: That is exactly the formula for variance that I showed you in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這正是前一部展示的變異數公式。

cues.en: And then here, I'm computing almost exactly the same formula, except I'm dividing by N instead of N minus 1.
cues.zh: 這裡幾乎一樣，但除以N，而非N−1。

cues.en: So in the previous video, I said that this was the appropriate division for a population variance and for a sample variance, you should divide by N minus 1.
cues.zh: 前一部說，這適用母體變異數，樣本應除N−1。

cues.en: If you apply this formula to a sample, then it's often called the biased variance.
cues.zh: 把這個公式用在樣本，常稱有偏變異數。

cues.en: So this would be unbiased variance and this is the biased variance.
cues.zh: 這是不偏，這是有偏。

cues.en: Now it's called biased variance, because in general, this is not trivially necessarily always the case, but in general, the biased variance will give you a smaller estimate of the variance
cues.zh: 稱有偏，是因為一般會得到較小估計，雖然不是簡單地永遠如此，

cues.en: compared to the unbiased variance.
cues.zh: 相較不偏變異數而言。

cues.en: And this is generally gonna be smaller, because we're dividing by a larger number.
cues.zh: 通常較小，因為除以較大的數。

cues.en: So the ratio itself becomes a little bit smaller.
cues.zh: 比值本身會小一點。

cues.en: Now it's not trivially the case, because it depends on exactly which data points you get, which depends on random chance and sampling variability and so on.
cues.zh: 但不那麼直接，取決於確切資料點，也就是隨機機會、抽樣變異等。

cues.en: Now is this really a huge deal?
cues.zh: 這真的影響很大嗎？

cues.en: We can imagine two different scenarios.
cues.zh: 想像兩種情況。

cues.en: When N is fairly large, like what it is here, 300, here we are dividing by 299 and here we're dividing by 300.
cues.zh: N很大，像這裡300，這裡除299，那裡除300。

cues.en: So is there really a huge difference between dividing by 299 and 300?
cues.zh: 除299與300，差很多嗎？

cues.en: Not really, as N gets larger, the difference becomes smaller and smaller.
cues.zh: 沒有，N越大，差異越小。

cues.en: But you can imagine that for small samples, maybe when N is eight, dividing by seven versus dividing by eight,
cues.zh: 但小樣本，例如N=8，除7或8，

cues.en: that can have a real impact on the measure of variance.
cues.zh: 對變異數可能真有影響。

cues.en: So this formula is exactly the same thing as computing.
cues.zh: 這個公式，完全相同於計算……

cues.en: Well, not exactly the same thing as this, but that would be if you would say Numpy.var with degrees of freedom being 1.
cues.zh: 不完全和這個相同，但相當於NumPy.var，設自由度1。

cues.en: So when you say denominator degrees of freedom equals 1, then python will divide by N minus 1.
cues.zh: 分母自由度1時，Python除以N−1。

cues.en: And if you don't say anything, so if you leave this second input empty like this, then NumPy is actually implementing this formula,
cues.zh: 若不指定，第二個輸入留空，NumPy其實實作這個公式，

cues.en: it's dividing by zero.
cues.zh: 除以0。

cues.en: Or you could also think of it as dividing by N minus zero.
cues.zh: 或者可想成除以N−0。

cues.en: All that said, so this was variance, here we get to standard deviation.
cues.zh: 以上是變異數，這裡是標準差。

cues.en: You can see that it's exactly the variance function and I'm inputting it into the square root function.
cues.zh: 完全一樣的變異數函式，放入平方根。

cues.en: And then I'm also computing the MAD, the mean absolute difference.
cues.zh: 也計算MAD，平均絕對差。

cues.en: And you can see that that looks really similar to variance, except that instead of squaring all of these values, I'm just taking their absolute values
cues.zh: 很像變異數，但不是平方，改取絕對值，

cues.en: and then summing up those absolute values.
cues.zh: 再把絕對值加總。

cues.en: I hope that all makes sense.
cues.zh: 希望都清楚。

cues.en: So that gets repeated for a range of different variances or standard deviations.
cues.zh: 對不同變異數、或標準差，重複計算。

cues.en: And now let's see what these look like.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: So a couple things to notice about this plot.
cues.zh: 圖上有幾點要注意。

cues.en: First of all, the unbiased variance and the biased variance, that's actually technically two lines here.
cues.zh: 不偏與有偏變異數，技術上是兩條線。

cues.en: Now on your screen, it might look like only one line, but it's actually two lines, and that's because when N is large like 300,
cues.zh: 螢幕上可能只看到一條，但其實兩條，因為N大，例如300，

cues.en: then the difference between biased and unbiased variance is actually really, really small.
cues.zh: 兩者差異非常非常小。

cues.en: You'd have to zoom in here to see a difference.
cues.zh: 必須放大才看得出。

cues.en: Now I encourage you to take a minute and change the end here to be something smaller, like I gave the example of eight before, but you can pick whatever number you like.
cues.zh: 鼓勵花一分鐘，把N改小，例如剛才的8，或任意喜歡的數。

cues.en: And you'll see that the difference between them becomes more apparent as N gets to be smaller.
cues.zh: N越小，差異越明顯。

cues.en: So standard deviation is small.
cues.zh: 標準差很小。

cues.en: Standard deviation grows only a little bit here.
cues.zh: 這裡只增加一點。

cues.en: And that's not so surprising, we have a square root here.
cues.zh: 不意外，因為取平方根。

cues.en: So these really big differences that come out with variants end up being smaller with square root or the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 變異數的巨大差異，取平方根、標準差後就小了。

cues.en: And then you can also see that the mean absolute difference and the standard deviation look pretty similar to each other.
cues.zh: 也能看到，平均絕對差與標準差相近。

cues.en: So they're a little bit more different than the bias and unbiased variance, but they're generally giving comparable results here.
cues.zh: 差異比有偏、不偏變異數大，但整體給出相近結果。

cues.en: So now I want to introduce you to these two measures of normalized variance that I discussed at the end of the previous lecture that was the Fano factor
cues.zh: 接著介紹前一堂最後談的兩個正規化變異程度量，Fano因子，

cues.en: and the coefficient of variation or CV.
cues.zh: 與變異係數，CV。

cues.en: And to illustrate this to you, I'm going to be generating what's called Poisson noise.
cues.zh: 透過產生卜瓦松雜訊來示範。

cues.en: Now I didn't talk too much about Poisson noise and I'm not gonna say too much about it in terms of what it means and what the formula is.
cues.zh: 沒有談太多，也不會深入意義與公式。

cues.en: Essentially, Poisson noise reflects a count of the number of times it takes to iterate up to some threshold.
cues.zh: 基本上，卜瓦松雜訊反映達到某門檻所需的迭代次數。

cues.en: And Poisson noise is important in various fields or disciplines in physics and in neuroscience and computational biology, but we don't really talk about it in this course.
cues.zh: 它對物理、神經科學與計算生物重要，但本課程不真正討論。

cues.en: However, I just chose to use Poisson noise here, partly because PO noise is purely positive value.
cues.zh: 這裡選用，部分因為卜瓦松雜訊只有正值。

cues.en: We don't have negative Poisson distributed data.
cues.zh: 沒有負的卜瓦松資料。

cues.en: And so that's important, because to compute the Fano factor and CV, we need positive value data.
cues.zh: 這很重要，算Fano因子與CV，需要正值。

cues.en: If you don't know why, then I encourage you to either look at the code down here or think about why that might be based on the formula that I showed in the previous video.
cues.zh: 不知道原因，鼓勵看下面程式，或根據前一部公式想想。

cues.en: So Poisson noise also has some pretty interesting properties that we are going to discover when we investigate its Fano factor.
cues.zh: 卜瓦松雜訊有些有趣性質，研究Fano因子時會發現。

cues.en: So here you see a plot of Poisson noise, 300 data points of Poisson noise.
cues.zh: 這是300個卜瓦松雜訊資料點。

cues.en: It looks a little funny, but that's because Poisson noise is all integer values.
cues.zh: 有點奇怪，因為全是整數。

cues.en: We don't have any fractions.
cues.zh: 沒有分數。

cues.en: And that's, again, because Poisson noise reflects the number of iterations it takes to reach some threshold.
cues.zh: 同樣，因為反映達到某門檻所需的迭代次數。

cues.en: So it doesn't make sense to have 2.2 iterations.
cues.zh: 2.2次迭代沒有意義。

cues.en: And here you see the distribution of these data.
cues.zh: 這是資料分布。

cues.en: So the histogram of these numbers.
cues.zh: 也就是這些數的直方圖。

cues.en: So now what I'm going to do is loop over different values of this key parameter for a Poisson distribution and that is called Lambda.
cues.zh: 接著走訪卜瓦松分布的關鍵參數，叫λ。

cues.en: And I'm allowing Lambda to range between 1 and 12.
cues.zh: 讓λ介於1到12。

cues.en: These don't need to be integer.
cues.zh: 不必是整數。

cues.en: And then inside this loop, I'm generating noise with a different Lambda parameter.
cues.zh: 迴圈內，用不同λ產生雜訊。

cues.en: And then here I'm computing the CV and the Fano factor.
cues.zh: 這裡算CV與Fano因子。

cues.en: You can see that these are both really similar to each other in terms of the formulas.
cues.zh: 兩者公式很相似。

cues.en: It's just that we have the standard deviation in the numerator or the variance in the numerator.
cues.zh: 只是一個分子是標準差，另一個是變異數。

cues.en: So let's see what this looks like.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: We'll get back to this plot in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後回到這張圖。

cues.en: So it's pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 很有意思。

cues.en: You see the Fano factor keeps oscillating around 1 here, whereas the CV is decreasing with increasing Lambda parameter.
cues.zh: Fano因子在1附近波動，CV則隨λ增加而下降。

cues.en: Now there's nothing particularly romantic about the Lambda equals four.
cues.zh: λ=4這裡沒有什麼特別浪漫的意義。

cues.en: You can see when I run that again, that's going to change.
cues.zh: 再執行就會改變。

cues.en: So it's just distributed around 1.
cues.zh: 只是分布在1附近。

cues.en: And that actually shows one of the really interesting properties of Poisson distributed noise, which is that a Poisson process has its variance equal to its mean.
cues.zh: 這展示卜瓦松雜訊很有趣的性質：變異數等於平均。

cues.en: So regardless of how you set Lambda, this parameter of the noise, the variance is always going to be equal to the mean.
cues.zh: 不論λ怎麼設，變異數總等於平均。

cues.en: Now in theory, for a Poisson process, the Fano factor is exactly one, but of course we are sampling a limited number of data,
cues.zh: 理論上Fano因子恰好1，但抽樣資料有限，

cues.en: so it won't be exactly one.
cues.zh: 不會恰好1。

cues.en: It's gonna be fluctuating around one.
cues.zh: 會在1附近波動。

cues.en: So this illustrates one of the applications of the Fano factor in physics and in computational biology.
cues.zh: 這展示Fano因子在物理與計算生物的一種應用。

cues.en: If you are taking measurements, you're taking observations from some process in nature and you want to know whether that process obeys a Poisson distribution,
cues.zh: 測量、觀察自然過程，想知道它是否服從卜瓦松分布，

cues.en: then you can compute the Fano factor of your data and if the Fano factor is one or very close to one, then that provides evidence
cues.zh: 可以計算Fano因子。若是1或很接近1，就提供證據，

cues.en: that you are looking at a Poisson distributed process.
cues.zh: 說明看到的是卜瓦松分布過程。

cues.en: So here's just a little question for you to think about.
cues.zh: 給你個小問題思考。

cues.en: I stressed a few moments ago the importance of setting the optional second input into the standard deviation and variance functions to be one,
cues.zh: 剛才強調，標準差、變異數函式的第二個選用輸入，要設1，

cues.en: to specify that we want a denominator degree of freedom of one here.
cues.zh: 指定分母自由度為1。

cues.en: So my question for you is, do we actually need that here?
cues.zh: 問題是，這裡真的需要嗎？

cues.en: Is it really important?
cues.zh: 真的重要嗎？

cues.en: Is it going to change how we interpret this result?
cues.zh: 會改變結果的解讀嗎？
